indicator_name: General government balance sheet (IMF GFS), billion KZT, end of year
description: Баланс активов и обязательств сектора госуправления (МВФ GFS), млрд тенге, на конец года
methodology: Financial assets and liabilities by instrument (F2 currency and deposits, F3 debt securities, F4 loans, F5 equity …), domestic/foreign, by sector; stocks at 31 December.
